gradient_reuse.decision: Do not prioritize whole-frame Gx/Gy solely for ROI overlap; only 5.39% interior reuse.

hazards: 19 bits required for count 262144; 18 bits overflows.
Same-bin consecutive updates require forwarding or II>1.
Two-pass DMA/control, histogram reset/scan and cache costs remain unmeasured.
No ROI frame buffer is assumed; PS resends packed input for pass two.
q8_radix_budget.decision: Model qualified on host. Need PS cost/packing budget from current board environment before HLS.

limitations: No board performance prediction from Windows timings.
Host reference uses float64 interpolation to match NumPy 1.21 semantics; board diagnostic verifies installed implementation.
No complete pipeline integration or RTL/HLS verification for the new model.
